ad_info.structure_source: library format F33 (Antes y después 3D con descuento en estrella) — estructuras/mv-01.json
ad_info.reference_style: 3D animated-movie style before/after supplement ad with campaign ribbon, headline panel, benefit icons, star badge and button
ad_info.angle_used: Transformación / resultado — the jean that finally fits (pain: jeans loose at the back)

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: soft sky blue #CFE6F5 background gradient and a warm yellow #FFD23F arrow.
global_identity.visual_style: Bold, feminine supplement ad in polished 3D animated-movie rendering; the real bottle stays sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Warm, confident and aspirational, believable and everyday; soft fuchsia glow on branded elements, never clinical.
global_identity.graphic_language: Solid flat color blocks, rounded cards and pills, thin glowing fuchsia borders, white thin-line icons, a curved yellow arrow, a many-pointed star badge, clean high-contrast typography readable on a phone.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look).

creative_objective: Stop the scroll with an obvious before/after of the same adult woman: before, her jeans hang loose and flat at the back and she looks frustrated in the mirror; after, on another day with another top, the same jeans are filled out and she smiles holding the closed bottle. The headline names her desire (the jean that finally fits), the star sells the full 3-bottle treatment and the button closes with 'Pagas al recibir'.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) fuchsia ribbon at top, 2) the before/after split, 3) headline on the plum panel, 4) the big bottle at bottom center, 5) the star badge, 6) the button and trust pill.
art_direction.composition_style: Three horizontal bands: top 15% ribbon, middle 50% before/after split with a thin white vertical divider, bottom 35% split into headline+icons (left), bottle (center, overlapping the band above), star+button (right).
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Generous margins of about 4% on every side; the bottle overlaps the boundary between the middle and bottom bands; icons evenly spaced in one cream card.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft cinematic 3D key light from the upper left, warm fill, gentle ambient occlusion; the bottle has a soft contact shadow and a faint fuchsia rim light.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 15%: a small caption between two thin horizontal lines, and below it a glossy fuchsia campaign ribbon with a small tag. Middle 50%: before (left) and after (right) of the same 3D woman, separated by a thin white vertical line, with a curved yellow arrow from left to right. Bottom 35%: left, a 3-line headline on a diagonal dark plum panel, under it a cream card with 4 line icons and short labels, under it a dark trust pill; center, the large closed bottle overlapping everything; right, a red-fuchsia many-pointed star with 'X3' and a big rounded button.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 supplement ad rendered in a polished 3D animated-movie style (soft subsurface skin, expressive faces), background a soft vertical gradient from sky blue #CFE6F5 at the top to pale blush #FBE3EE at the bottom. TOP ZONE (0–15%): centered small caption 'PLAN NATURAL DE 3 MESES' in plum #2B1226 Poppins Bold uppercase between two thin plum horizontal lines; directly below, a wide glossy hot-fuchsia #E6177F ribbon banner with a thin white inner outline and a soft fuchsia glow, slightly tilted, with a small tag shape on its right end, carrying the white italic Montserrat Black text 'SIN AGUJAS NI QUIRÓFANO'. MIDDLE ZONE (15–65%): split in two equal halves by a thin white vertical line. LEFT HALF = BEFORE (about 28% of the canvas): an adult Latina woman in her late 20s with adult features, wavy dark-brown hair in a loose bun with strands falling, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a plain grey cotton tank top and mid-blue high-waist jeans that are one size too big at the back: a baggy fold of extra denim below the seat, drooping back pockets, one straight flat vertical line from waist to thigh, thin straight thighs with loose fabric. She stands three-quarters turned in front of a tall bedroom mirror with a beige wall behind, framed from head to mid-thigh, looking back over her shoulder at the camera with raised eyebrows, worried mouth and one hand pulling the loose waistband away from her back; flat cool morning light. RIGHT HALF = AFTER, another day: the same woman (same face, hair, earrings) now in a fitted white ribbed top, hair in a high ponytail, warmer golden afternoon light, framed from head to mid-thigh, three-quarters turned, big genuine smile toward the camera; curvy hourglass figure: her hips about one and a half times wider than her small waist, the same blue jeans now filled out and rounded at the back, thicker thighs filling the jean legs, the change obvious at first glance but natural, not caricature, tasteful and fully clothed. In her front hand, held next to her shoulder at the same distance from the camera as her face, she holds the closed product bottle facing the camera, label readable; her other hand rests on her hip and holds nothing. A thick curved warm-yellow #FFD23F arrow with a soft shadow goes from the before half toward the after half at mid-height. BOTTOM ZONE (63–100%): LEFT 45%: a diagonal dark plum #2B1226 panel with rounded corner carrying the 3-line headline in white italic Montserrat Black uppercase, the last line in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0; under it a rounded cream #FBE3EE card with four thin-line plum icons (a heart-shaped hourglass silhouette, a lightning bolt, a small calendar with a check mark, a leaf) each above two-line plum Poppins Bold uppercase labels, separated by thin vertical lines; under the card a dark plum pill with a fuchsia-bordered shield badge carrying the registration text in white, a thin divider, and a small box icon with '3 FRASCOS · 3 MESES' in white. CENTER: the real product bottle, large, about 40% of the canvas height, standing upright and facing the camera, overlapping the middle and bottom zones, soft contact shadow and faint fuchsia rim light. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth. The black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA' and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; always closed with its cap on; the label reads the right way round, never mirrored; the bottle stays photographic and sharp even inside the 3D scene. RIGHT 30% of the bottom zone: a bold many-pointed star badge in hot fuchsia #E6177F with a deep magenta #B0105E inner shadow and a thin yellow edge, carrying a huge yellow 'X3' with a plum outline and, under it, 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO' in white Montserrat ExtraBold on two lines; under the star a wide rounded fuchsia button with a soft drop shadow, white Montserrat Black text 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' and a white circle with a plum arrow on its right end. All texts crisp, spelled exactly, accents correct, nothing else written anywhere.

mandatory_visual_elements: The same adult 3D woman in both halves, before on the left and after on the right, same framing (head to mid-thigh, three-quarters turned)
Before: grey tank top, jeans one size too big at the back with a baggy fold and drooping pockets, frustrated face, hand pulling the loose waistband, in front of a bedroom mirror
After: white ribbed top, ponytail, warmer light, jeans filled out, big smile, holding the closed bottle near her shoulder
Thin white vertical divider and the curved yellow arrow
Fuchsia ribbon at the top and the small caption between thin lines
Diagonal plum headline panel, cream icon card with 4 icons, dark trust pill with a bordered shield badge
The real closed product bottle, large, at bottom center, identical to the attached photo, label facing camera and readable
Fuchsia many-pointed star with 'X3' and the big fuchsia button 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR'
final_generation_exclusions: No loose capsules, no pills, no open bottle, no second product, no other brand
No organs, glowing body parts, cellulite or medical overlays
No nudity, no lingerie, no rear view crop centered on the body; both poses stay three-quarters with the face visible
No prices, percentages, 'Black Friday', countdowns, ratings, testimonials or 'envío gratis'
No logos; never write the words 'AGREGAR' or 'LOGO Y SELLO DE'
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No promise of body enlargement, no 'sin ejercicio', no guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts; the headline states a desire, and the before/after is tasteful, fully clothed and in 3D.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
